protocol.cohort: released_reference; retain all released labelled rows, including known Phish conflict
protocol.split: unchanged graph masks; one partition; no resplitting
protocol.configuration_source: public utils.py defaults, also used by accepted study; not a recovered paper-table winner
protocol.decision: p1 > 0.5; exact tie -> class0; no threshold search
protocol.preprocessing: public decoder generated normalized interaction views + unchanged source14
protocol.checkpoint_rule: latest validation Macro-F1 tie; stop stale >50
protocol.sampler: actual PyG NeighborLoader directional; per-role cached draws shared across model seeds
protocol.meta_loss: public-code unsquared L2 TripletMarginLoss mean, margin .3; differs from squared/sum paper equation
protocol.test_policy: freeze all five seed estimators/checkpoints before test cache or test inference
protocol.setting: static transductive; topology and unlabeled held-out features may be sampled as neighbors
protocol.inference: descriptive seed variation on one released split; not independent-split uncertainty

data.mapping_scope: audited labelled-root mapping bound to known graph and raw table bytes; not rebuilding all raw nodes
